## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The failure-report selector should be fixed because it drops requested tests whose reported paths begin with `./`.

## Changes
The pull request adds selection from failure reports, refactors cached selection, and adds tests for all three selectors.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize failure-report paths before matching — With `report={"failed": ["./tests/test_x.py"]}` and `requested={"tests/test_x.py"}`, you return `[]`. Both existing selectors normalize paths before matching; the new selector compares the raw spelling directly. — Reports containing `./`-prefixed paths silently omit requested failed tests, so reruns can skip the failures they should execute. — Fix: Compare `normalize(path)` with `requested` while returning the original `path`, and extend `test_failure_report_selection`.
